All signs.voice_body: OPEN YOUR EYES TO THE SUN’S HARD LOOK TODAY. The Sun’s opposition to Saturn at 12:00 am urges you to confront stubborn limits—think of a stubborn project or a habit that resists change. Symbolically, this clash is a call to set realistic goals, to honor structure while staying flexible. Embrace the tension as a chance to re‑evaluate priorities, then draft a clear, achievable plan. ACT: write down one concrete step to align your routine with a new boundary.
